contentText:
Ella Langley & Morgan Wallen’s “I Can’t Love You Anymore” re-enters the top 10 of the Hot 100. Will any of Ella’s top 10 entries take No. 1 from Taylor Swift’s “I Knew It, I Knew You”?

Tetris Kelly:

This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated July 4. “Dracula” is back at its No. 10 peak. Ella and Morgan rise to No. 9. “Man I Need” is up to 8, as is Ariana Grande to 7. And Drake to 6. Olivia’s “Drop Dead” slips to No. 5, as does her “Stupid Song” to No. 4.
